$comment: Constructors of ONE priority in one unit run in the order the unit DEFINES them (src/link/static_init_tables.hpp states the decision, its measurement and what it refuses). `wc` is prototyped before `wa` and `wb` are defined, so the unit numbers it first and an order taken from ids runs it first; one unit, so the link renumbers nothing. The stdout is the order, the exit code the count (three ran). Every constructor is `static` and called from nowhere, so the release arm also needs the optimizer to keep the schedule's functions. FOUR TARGETS: pe runs natively on the Windows gate host, elf x86_64 + arm64 under qemu on Linux, macho on darwin.
